companyFieldUpdates.description: TowerPoint Infrastructure Partners is a U.S. wireless-infrastructure platform that acquires, owns, and manages towers, easements, rooftops, and related telecom real estate for wireless carriers and other network operators. The business traces its operating roots to 2007 and reported more than 900 assets across 49 states and approximately $1.5 billion invested by year-end 2025. Meritage Group and Ullico Infrastructure Fund entered through the December 2024 recapitalization, and Munich Re later acquired a 15.0% interest through MEAG-managed MR Highland. TowerPoint Capital manages the platform; its direct equity participation is not publicly disclosed and is not recorded as ownership.
